categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Meishuo Electric Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of relay control components and derivative actuators including fluid electromagnetic valves. Its main products include general relays, automotive relays, latching relays, new energy relays, communication relays, and fluid electromagnetic valves, serving sectors such as household appliances, smart homes, automotive manufacturing, photovoltaic inverters, charging piles, smart meters, industrial control, and communication facilities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including automated and semi-automated production lines, high-speed precision machining, CCD imaging inspection, automated electrical parameter testing, and high-precision potting technology. It integrates technologies from automatic control, mechanical design, laser processing, modular programming, and real-time control algorithms to produce high-quality relay products. The production process is customer order-driven with flexible batch production for customized products, supported by ERP, MES, and PLM systems for intelligent manufacturing and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading brands in household appliances such as Midea, AUX, TCL, Galanz, Haier, Deye, Xiaomi, BYD, and HELLA. The products are widely used in home appliances, smart home systems, automotive manufacturing, photovoltaic inverters, charging stations, smart meters, industrial control, and communication systems. The company maintains long-term cooperative relationships with these customers and provides customized product development and full-process services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Zhejiang Province. Domestic sales account for over 94% of revenue, while exports constitute a smaller portion. It has established a wholly-owned subsidiary in Shenzhen to expand market coverage and enhance competitiveness. The company is also actively exploring overseas markets to broaden its industry and customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Meishuo Electric Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying relay components and electromagnetic valves to downstream customers in various industries. It procures raw materials such as hardware, plastic parts, contacts, and enameled wire directly from manufacturers to ensure cost efficiency and quality control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation with a focus on developing high-load, small-size, low-power consumption relays for new energy and automotive sectors. It invests in R&D for ultra-small, high-insulation, modular, and intelligent relay products, as well as fluid electromagnetic valves with enhanced performance and noise reduction. The strategy includes strengthening the R&D team, upgrading experimental facilities, deepening industry-academia collaboration, and accelerating the commercialization of high-value products to consolidate market position.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of physical products, including relays and fluid electromagnetic valves. The company adopts a direct sales model, with revenue recognized upon transfer of control of goods to customers, either through direct shipment or consignment inventory. Pricing is based on cost plus target gross margin, considering factors such as raw material costs, customer brand, order scale, and market competition.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the electrical machinery and equipment manufacturing industry, specifically in power electronic components manufacturing. It holds a competitive position by focusing on quality, innovation, and customer service, with certifications such as ISO9001, IATF16949, and UL laboratory accreditation. Major competitors include domestic and international relay manufacturers, but Meishuo distinguishes itself through advanced manufacturing capabilities, strong R&D, and stable partnerships with leading brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 633 million, representing an 18.77% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 27.3 million, a decrease of 37.08% compared to 2023. The company has a registered capital of RMB 100.8 million and total assets exceeding RMB 1.25 billion. It has experienced growth in sales volume and production capacity, with ongoing investments in production line expansion and R&D facilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Meishuo Electric Technology emphasizes high product quality, reliability, and customization capabilities to meet stringent customer requirements across diverse applications. Its value proposition includes advanced automated manufacturing, comprehensive quality management systems, rapid R&D response to customer needs, and the ability to produce products compliant with global standards. The company also offers modular and intelligent relay solutions, enhancing customer satisfaction and fostering long-term partnerships.
